records.text: Jack Solomon graduated from Utah Valley University, created its Center for Jewish Studies, taught political science at BYU, and formerly directed BYU's Jerusalem Center.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He graduated from what is today known as Utah Valley University. ... He also created on their campus the Center for Jewish Studies. ... Jack Solomon was also a professor at BYU in political science. ... He's the former director of the University's Jerusalem Center.

verification.notes: Available biographical data lists Jack Solomon's education at Los Angeles City College, Los Angeles State College, and California State University rather than Utah Valley University. BYU's institutional history identifies David Galbraith, not Solomon, as the Jerusalem Center's first director, contradicting the central assertions.

records.text: The CIA recruits directly from BYU and specifically from BYU's Jerusalem Center.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep rupRLXmSndU)

appearances.snippet: fortunately, someone told me. ... BYU has direct ties to the CIA. ... They recruit directly from BYU. And I am saying this with 100% certainty, it is not a conspiracy, and what is even more odd is that they recruit specifically from BYU Jerusalem in Israel.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous BYU reporting confirms that the CIA openly recruited and interviewed students at BYU and valued the university language programs. No current authoritative evidence was found that the CIA recruited specifically through the BYU Jerusalem Center. The general BYU recruitment claim is supported; the Jerusalem-specific extension is not.

records.text: Elite Mormon students at BYU's Jerusalem Center are introduced to one another and to the Knesset, and some are approached there by teachers about working for the CIA.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep rupRLXmSndU)

appearances.snippet: BYU, the Jerusalem Center, this person told me, is where the elite of the Mormon culture, the cream of the pie, they get introduced to one another. It's where the elite Mormon youth are introduced to also the Knesset, okay? ... where many of them are then approached in Jerusalem, Israel by their teachers who I should mention the director of the program is Israeli to work for the CIA.

verification.notes: BYU historical material supports that Jerusalem Center students had exposure to Israeli institutions, including Knesset visits, and that Israeli faculty and administrators participated in the program. No reliable evidence supports the anonymous allegation that teachers selected and approached elite Mormon students on behalf of the CIA. Peripheral program details are supported, while the central recruitment mechanism is not.
